acceptance.criterion: flatten(nested) returns every leaf of arbitrarily nested lists, left to right

acceptance.check: python3 -c "from fl import flatten; assert flatten([])==[]"

checks.command: python3 -c "from fl import flatten; assert flatten([])==[]"

diff:
diff --git a/fl.py b/fl.py
--- a/fl.py
+++ b/fl.py
@@ -1,2 +1,10 @@
+def _walk(node):
+    for item in node:
+        if isinstance(item, list):
+            yield from _walk(item)
+        else:
+            yield item
+
+
 def flatten(nested):
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    return list(_walk(nested))
